feeding_claim.verbatim: made from steak and roast trimmings from our grass finished beef.

notes: Fourth-generation family ranch. Read homepage, all products, burger collection, 90/10 burger, 90/10 grass finished burger and KC strip pages. Sells separate grain finished and grass finished lines: the plain 90/10 burger is from our grain finished beef, the grass finished burgers are from our grass finished beef, and the KC strip offers Akaushi Wagyu, Grain Finished and Grass Finished options, so category is both. Farm pickup in Derby Mon to Thu 10 to 6, Fri and Sat 10 to 8. Site says it is no longer shipping out of state due to UPS and dry ice costs; whether it ships within Kansas is not stated. Kansas Grown! Farmers Market outdoor season closed for winter, indoor dates on site. Second phone (316) 765-3878 also listed. No quarter or half beef; 25 and 50 lb burger bundles only. Site does not explicitly say the cattle are raised on the ranch beyond 'directly from our farm'; Verifier may confirm.
